page_title: ALM 6-1 CAD | Almeria v Cadiz CF 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
87' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Borja Vazquez (Cadiz) replacing Robert Navarro.
87' Mauricio Pellegrino prepares a substitution. Joseba Zaldua is replaced by Iza Carcelen (Cadiz).
86' 6 - 1 Sergio Arribas (Almeria) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
84' Jonathan Viera comes off the pitch to be replaced by Luka Romero (Almeria).
82' The total number of attempts is 24:10.
81' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
78' Fali (Cadiz) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
78' Mateo Busquets Ferrer rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Adrian Embarba (Almeria).
76' Pepe Mel has decided to substitute Luis Suarez and he is replaced by Ibrahima Kone (Almeria).
74' The attendance for today's match is 7558.
71' 5 - 1 Goal! Luis Suarez (Almeria) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:1.
70' Here comes a substitution. Brian Ocampo is given a rest as he is replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
67' The substitution has been made. Paco Sanz (Almeria) has replaced Aleksandar Radovanovic.
65' 4 - 1 Jonathan Viera finds Luis Suarez (Almeria) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 4:1.
64' Mauricio Pellegrino decides to make a substitution. Gonzalo Escalante will be replaced by Diadie Samassekou (Cadiz).
64' Substitution. Alex Fernandez will be replaced by Juanmi (Cadiz).
63' Luis Suarez (Almeria) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
61' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' 3 - 1 Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) is totally disorientated and accidentally puts the ball into his own goal!
56' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
51' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
48' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Adrian Embarba provided an assist for the goal.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Leo Baptistao comes off for Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
46' Pepe Mel makes a switch. Gonzalo Melero is coming on in place of Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Mateo Busquets Ferrer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' A precise low pass is received by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
43' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing. Good work from Cadiz CF as they win a corner.
40' Marc Pubill (Almeria) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
39' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Luis Suarez (Almeria) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
34' The ratio of the ball possession is 50:50.

30' 0 - 1 Goal! Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Fernando Martinez had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.

28' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
27' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
23' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer saw the whole situation.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Suarez (Almeria) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Rough tackle by Luis Suarez (Almeria). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Cadiz CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
19' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows the whistle, Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is penalised for a foul.
15' Luis Suarez (Almeria) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
14' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
13' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
12' The game is interrupted. Roger Marti (Cadiz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
11' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.

8' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
7' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Luis Suarez (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Luis Suarez (Almeria) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Gil, who smothers the ball.
4' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adrian Embarba (Almeria).
2' Chumi (Almeria) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets Ferrer no option but to blow his whistle.

The players are out at last! Cadiz CF will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will supervise the game today.
